repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-encryption
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for encryption and the Key Management Service (KMS) client. It registers webex.internal.encryption with a kms child, negotiates the KMS session (with optional certificate-chain enforcement and report-only CA-root trials), fetches and caches keys, encrypts and decrypts text, binary data, and SCRs, downloads encrypted files, and wraps and unwraps KMS messages in service payloads.

Internal plugin: semantic versioning is not strictly followed. Per-member detail lives in the owning module spec Public surface and the JSDoc of src/encryption.js and src/kms.js.
